summary: Adicet Bio furnished an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing positive preliminary Phase 1 data for prula-cel in systemic lupus erythematosus, with or without lupus nephritis, and hosting a webcast on September 28, 2026. Data as of an August 28, 2026 cutoff covered 22 patients (16 LN, 6 extra-renal) with 6-21 months follow-up; at 12 months, 50% of evaluable LN patients achieved complete renal response and 54% achieved DORIS remission. No transactional terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are present; this is a clinical-data event, not a special situation.
